body: This is basically a git cherry pick fail. I fixed it only to lose it when I was cleaning up the commits... Thx Lee!

Should this be cherry-picked somewhere else as well?

I think this test fails because we rollback a replica to the global checkpoint(https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/33473) but do not restore its history on promotion. This should be fixed by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/33616.
